If not specified, defaults to meters. So if we pass radius as e.g., 0.05 m? Wait radius input should match unit param. For centimeter, set unit='cm' so result will be in cm. Call calculate_circumference({radius:5, unit:'cm'}) -> returns something like 31.4159? Because 2π*5=31.4159 cm.
